skip_tests.reason: These tests open database files written with fixed-size decimal columns, which this config cannot read
Serialized plans in these fixtures carry fixed-size decimal values
Wide decimals compute round/ceil/floor/trunc, approx_quantile, reservoir_quantile and the quantile interpolation in DOUBLE
Wide decimals are averaged as DOUBLE and a wide quantile parameter is handled as DOUBLE, neither can overflow like the HUGEINT arithmetic of the fixed-size decimals
NUMERIC narrows the result of an arithmetic kernel to the smallest fixed-size decimal that holds it; with every decimal stored wide the representation keeps the full width
Wide decimals carry string statistics, arithmetic on them propagates no numeric min/max
The optimizer rewrites of decimal aggregates (avg, partial aggregate pushdown, aggregate function rewrite) and the plans they produce apply to fixed-size decimals
VARIANT shreds DECIMAL values into fixed-size typed vectors, which cannot hold a decimal stored as BIGNUM blobs
A wide decimal Value renders as a string literal cast in SQL text
A DOUBLE is converted from its exact binary expansion (0.1235 -> 0.123); the fixed-size decimals round after a floating multiply (0.124)
The BIGNUM sum cannot overflow while accumulating, only the width check of the result reports the overflow
Wide decimal columns are written without a Parquet bloom filter, and their size differs from the fixed-size columns
The compression method depends on the physical type of the column
